response.sql: WITH high_telescopes AS (SELECT t.telescregistry, t.bandusagepct, o.weathprofile FROM telescopes t INNER JOIN observatories o ON o.observstation = t.observstation WHERE t.detecttempk > 152.1), profile_stats AS (SELECT weathprofile, AVG(bandusagepct) AS avg_bandusage, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count FROM high_telescopes GROUP BY weathprofile), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_bandusage) AS mean_profile_avg FROM profile_stats) SELECT p.weathprofile, p.avg_bandusage, p.telescope_count, p.avg_bandusage - o.mean_profile_avg AS deviation_from_mean FROM profile_stats p CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE o.mean_profile_avg IS NOT NULL;

assumptions.assumption: Telescopes are matched to observatories with an inner join on observstation, so telescopes with no matching observatory are dropped.

"High side of a 152.1 cutoff" means detecttempk strictly greater than 152.1, and telescopes with a NULL detecttempk are excluded. The request does not settle whether the cutoff value itself is included.
Telescopes with a NULL weathprofile form their own group rather than being dropped, and that group is included in the mean of per-profile averages.
The telescope count for each profile counts all matched telescopes in that group, including those whose bandusagepct is NULL. Only the average ignores NULLs.

alternatives.interpretation: "High side" includes the cutoff value itself, so telescopes with detecttempk equal to 152.1 are kept.
